tools.description: Write (or overwrite) your plan as Markdown to .harw/plans/<slug>.md. The only writing tool in plan mode; it cannot write anywhere else. Repeated calls in this session overwrite the same plan unless you pass a new slug. Suggested structure: Context / Approach in steps / Affected files / Verification.
tools.name: plan.write

slug.description: Optional file name: lowercase a-z, 0-9 and '-', max 64 chars. Omit to keep the current plan of this session.

title.description: Optional title; used to derive the slug of a new plan.

tools.description: Present the finished plan to the user for approval (like ExitPlanMode). The TUI shows it with three options: implement in auto mode, implement with per-change approval, or keep planning with feedback. Only works in plan mode, only in the interactive TUI. Call it only after plan.write.
tools.name: plan.exit

plan_path.description: The plan written with plan.write, e.g. .harw/plans/<slug>.md

tools.description: Suggest switching to plan mode (read-only exploration, then a written plan) for a larger or risky task. The user must confirm; nothing changes without her.
tools.name: plan.enter

reason.description: One sentence why planning first is worth it.

tools.description: Ask the user 1-4 multiple-choice questions (2-4 options each, free text 'Other' is always offered) in a selection window and get her answers. Use it to clarify requirements instead of guessing. Read-only. Not available outside the interactive TUI: then make an assumption and state it.
tools.name: ask_user

questions.description: 1-4 questions shown together in one selection window.

header.description: Optional very short tab label (max 24 chars), e.g. "Auth".

multi_select.description: true lets the user pick several options.

options.description: 2-4 distinct options. Do NOT add an "Other" option; the UI always offers free text.

description.description: Optional one-line explanation of the option and its trade-off.

label.description: Short option label (max 80 chars), returned as the answer.

question.description: The complete question, ending with a question mark.
